description: Flavour graph for The Deadline. Called by script_venue_regular via the trigger's voice param.

f0.text: Two people are arguing about whether you used to be on television. Neither of them will ask you.

f1.text: The room makes space at the good end without anyone appearing to decide to.

f2.text: Someone introduces you to a stranger with a job title you have never held and don't correct.

r0.text: A producer you have never met greets you by a name that's nearly yours and moves on, satisfied.

r1.text: The drink-printer starts your order unprompted, which around here is called a relationship.

r2.text: Someone waves you into a booth mid-anecdote, on the assumption you already know who everyone in it is.

s0.text: The drink-printer notices you before any of the people do, and it's only being polite because it's a machine.

s1.text: Someone glances up, decides you aren't talent, and returns to a conversation about a show nobody is making.

s2.text: The tinted glass shifts a shade darker, which the room chooses to interpret as atmosphere rather than a fault.

name: Venue voice — The Deadline
